title: Installation Jobs: Large-Opening Adder for Lead-Safe Work
content:
**Large openings under lead-safe practices — Installation Jobs**

Larger openings disturb more paint. When the lead-safe fee of an **Installation Jobs** record is priced, a large-opening adder follows the oversize openings recorded above the series' standard size at the latest completed measure of the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs — the most recent measure visit of that contract with a completed outcome:

| Oversize openings recorded at that measure | Large-opening adder |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | $90.00 |
| 1 to 3 | $45.00 |
| none | none |

The adder is a single amount for the job, added to the fee. A door job, which installs no window contract, has no oversize opening and no large-opening adder.

## Cases (hypothetical measures)

| Latest completed measure | Earlier completed measure | Adder |
|---|---|---|
| 5 oversize openings | 2 oversize openings | $90.00 |
| 2 oversize openings | 6 oversize openings | $45.00 |
| no oversize opening | 3 oversize openings | none |

Only the latest completed measure decides.
